role: Seeds the river stack: every non-ocean cell gets a random value 2..300000, ocean stays 0.
scope_reason: Part of the overworld biome layer stack (GenLayer.initializeAllBiomeGenerators) that decides the biome of every overworld column.

members.name: GenLayerRiverInit
members.note: Built by mk() inside layers_init with the same base seed and parent.

notes: layers.c builds the stack as a pointer graph of struct layer nodes (p1, p2) in a fixed 64-node array and recurses through it, and each layer mallocs its parent area per call (area()); both are GPU-contract hazards but outside the tick (chunk generation). Status exact rests on test_worldgen comparing genbiomes and biomes stages against the oracle chunk dumps; the gate was not re-run for this record.
